# logistic-like with time growth: P*(1-P/K) times r(t) plus additive S(t)

import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t)
best=[]
def r2(cols):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    res=dP_dt-A@c
    return 1-np.sum(res**2)/np.sum((dP_dt-dP_dt.mean())**2), c
for th in np.linspace(0.2,3,29):
  for K in np.linspace(2,40,39):
    cols=[one,t,P,t*P,P**(1+th),t*P**(1+th),t*t,P*np.log(P)]
    v,c=r2(cols); best.append((v,th,K,'Pth'))
    cols=[one,t,P,t*P,P**th,t*P**th,t*t,np.log(P)]
    v,c=r2(cols); best.append((v,th,K,'Pth2'))
    cols=[one,t,t*t,P*(1-(P/K)**th),t*P*(1-(P/K)**th),np.exp(-P/K),t*np.exp(-P/K)]
    v,c=r2(cols); best.append((v,th,K,'logi'))
best.sort(reverse=True)
for b in best[:6]: print(b)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    lp = np.log(P)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*P + params[3]*P*P + params[4]*t*P
            + params[5]*t*t + params[6]*P*lp + params[7]*t*P*lp + params[8]*lp
            + params[9]*t*lp)
